Name: Nuka-World
Author: DomTSVG
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/NNrNIQS.png[/img]﻿[/center]
[left][b][center]A mod that brings the refreshing, sugary taste of Nuka-Cola to Stardew Valley![/center]

[/b][center][size=5][b][u]Features[/u][/b][/size][/center]
Nuka-World adds 10 different flavors of Nuka-Cola that can be bought/cooked. All the recipes and drinks, as well as the special weapon that comes with this mod are available to purchase from the Nuka-Cola machine.

[i][b]This mod adds:[/b][/i]
Nuka-Cola
Nuka-Cherry
Nuka-Grape
Nuka-Orange
Nuka-Dark
Nuka-Cola Wild
Nuka-Cranberry
Nuka-Cola Quartz
Nuka-Cola Quantum
Nuka-Cola Victory
The Nuka Breaker Club

You can find the Nuka-Cola machine tucked away in the corner of the Quarry, next to the minecart.

[center][size=5][u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u]
[/size][/center]
The way Nuka-World is built means it [b]should be compatible with every mod under the sun, including all Content Patcher, JSONAssets, and other mods[/b] that add items into the game. If you run into incompatibility issues, please make sure to let me know so I can work on fixing them. Even if you have another mod that adds Nuka-Cola items, it shouldn't conflict with Nuka-World.

Nuka-World may conflict [i]only[/i] with mods that change the Mountain map, and only if something important is placed where the vending machine is. If there's an issue like this, let me know and I'll make a patch for that mod.

[i][b]Nuka-World has been personally tested with and is compatible with the following mods:[/b][/i]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9949]Plentiful Harvest[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6830]The Love of Cooking[/url]﻿

[size=5][center][u][b]Installation[/b][/u][/center][/size]

You can follow the guide below to install this mod. Make sure to have all the dependencies!

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI (Stardew Modding API)[/url].
[*]Install all required mods, including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Download and extract my mod .zip folder.
[*]Drag and drop [b]ALL 3[/b] mod folders into your Stardew Valley Mod Folder (\Stardew Valley\Mods).
[*]Run Stardew Valley through SMAPI and check for any errors. (I would also either start a test file or load a save to see if SMAPI throws errors.)
[/list]
